title: East End Jet Ski
specs: Large 5-mile perimeter for jet ski riding or tours in Shinnecock Canal
Private beach on Peconic Bay for instruction and safety courses
Must be 18 years or older to rent a jet ski with valid identification (preferably a license)
Anyone younger can ride with the renter
Jet boat holds up to 10 people
blurb: Tired of being a spectator? Discover the most exciting sport ever to hit the water. For over 40 Years East End Jet Ski has been your source for fun in the sun. Our qualified professionals are always on premises and offer a full class of instruction and fit you into a life jacket. For your convenience the water is not over five feet in any spot and someone will be in the water and on land watching at all times.
extraNote: $20 deposit required for jet ski rental, refunded at end of ride · Lunch not included, available for additional $100 per ski · Jet boat rentals require minimum 2 hour rental · Boat rentals are with operator only, no exceptions · No reservations, first come first serve · 91 Foster Ave. at the foot of the Ponquogue Bridge, Hampton Bays, NY
